column1: Note 1:W=wanted user, I1=interfering user 1, I2=interfering user 2.Note 2:The resource allocation per user is given as (N_group_PHICH, N_seq_PHICH).Note 3:The power offsets (per user) represent the difference of the power of BPSK modulated symbol per PHICH relative to the first interfering user.Note 4:A=fixed ACK, R=random ACK/NACK.
